scan_tool: manual ASVS review + rg pattern audit + dependency audit (static analysis)

A01_broken_access_control.evidence: RLS enforced in migration 20260826000010: authenticated SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on inventory_movements, DELETE denied; UI never constructs privileged queries; routes guarded by _protected auth wrapper.

A02_cryptographic_failures.justification: Increment handles no secrets or crypto; Supabase client uses HTTPS + JWTs managed by platform.

A03_injection.evidence: All queries go through supabase-js parameterized filters; sanitizeSearchTerm strips ILIKE/fts operators [,()_%] before user text reaches .or() filter grammar on both search paths (summary.tsx:49 and products.tsx via sanitizeSearchTerm(search) at the useProducts call — the products gap found in independent review was fixed and re-verified in-browser); tests/inventory-logic.test.ts 'ILIKE wildcards are stripped'.

A04_insecure_design.evidence: Negative-stock adjustments require explicit second confirmation; reason is mandatory for auditability; adjustments stored signed in inventory_movements.

A05_security_misconfiguration.evidence: Prototype mode requires explicit missing env vars; no credentials in code; .env.local gitignored.

A06_vulnerable_and_outdated_components.evidence: pnpm workspace on current majors; vite build clean; no known-critical transitive advisories surfaced during install.

A07_identification_and_authentication_fa.evidence: JWT session via useAuth; created_by set from authenticated user id server-policy-side, never from form input.

A08_software_and_data_integrity_failures.evidence: Client-side validation (parseAdjustmentQuantity rejects NaN/zero/round-to-zero) with authoritative RLS as server enforcement; movement_type constrained to view contract values.

A09_logging_and_monitoring_failures.evidence: Every adjustment persisted as inventory_movements row with reason, actor, date — tamper-evident audit trail (DELETE denied by RLS).

A10_server_side_request_forgery.justification: No server-side fetching of user-supplied URLs in this increment; browser app talks only to configured Supabase origin.

residual_risks.description: Negative-stock race: two concurrent adjustments could both pass the warning check before either commits; accepted because RLS permits the operations and stock is advisory, not reservation-grade.

notes: Detailed reasoning in prime/reports/phase-5-security-testing.md; no open critical or high findings.
